blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: An edge video analytics system must estimate the quality of local detections since there are no ground-truth labels available during runtime. Detectors usually provide confidence scores for their results, but these scores can not reveal every missed object or misplaced bounding box. So a quality estimator is necessary to provide a decision signal indicating which frame has potential detection failures that need to be escalated to a more powerful model in the cloud. Neural network based estimators add workload to the GPU already running detection, while CPU capacity may remain available. We present Predictive Temporal Consistency IoU (PTC-IoU), which moves this workload to CPU by compacting detection boxes histories to support deterministic result scoring. Comparing to neural counterparts, experiments on representative edge hardware, Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano, show that our method reduced per-frame estimator latency from 10.3 ms for neural counterparts to 2.2 ms (4.7x faster), increased pipelined throughput by 13.6%, and cuts estimator energy consumption by up to 95%, while maintaining competitive final detection quality verified on multiple datasets.
blocks.zh: 边缘视频分析系统必须估计本地检测的质量,因为在运行期间没有地面真实标签。 探测器通常会为其结果提供置信分数,但这些分数无法揭示出每一个被丢失的对象或错误的边框. 因此,质量估测器对于提供决策信号来说是必要的,它表明哪个帧有潜在的检测故障,需要升级为云中更强大的模型. 基于神经网络的估算器会给已经运行的GPU检测器增加工作量,而CPU能力可能仍然可用. 我们介绍预测性时间一致性IoU(PTC-IoU),它通过压缩检测箱历史,支持确定性结果分数,将工作量转移到CPU。 与神经对应物相比,关于代表性边缘硬件Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano的实验显示,我们的方法将每帧神经对应物的视距从10.3 ms降低到2.2 ms(4.7x更快),管道吞吐量增加13.6%,将视距能耗削减到95%,同时维持在多个数据集上核实的竞争性最终检测质量.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: A roadside camera paired with a cloud server needs to detect vehicles continuously under limited compute and communication capacity. Fig. 1 demonstrates that a lightweight detector on edge devices can process each frame locally, while a stronger model in the cloud can assist with only the difficult images. The device therefore faces a second task alongside detection: deciding which results to keep or send to the cloud for stronger inference. This is called selective offloading .
blocks.zh: 与云服务器对接的路边相机需要在有限的计算和通信能力下不断检测出车辆. 图1显示,边缘设备上的轻量级探测器可以在当地处理每个帧,而云中更强大的模型则只能帮助困难的图像. 因此,该设备在探测的同时面临第二个任务:决定哪些结果可以保存或发送到云中进行更强的推断. 这叫做选择性卸载。

blocks.en:
Selective offloading decision requires information that the detector does not directly provide. A detector returns object locations as bounding boxes, together with classes and confidence scores.
Though a car may be confidently detected, this does not indicate whether another car was missed, or whether the detected box is accurately placed [ 1 ] .
During runtime, there are no ground-truth labels against which to check the result.
In selective offloading , quality estimators provide a decision signal for choosing only suspicious frames for cloud offloading before spending the communication and server-compute budget, to maximize the final detection quality while lowering the offload cost.
blocks.zh:
选择性卸载决定需要检测器不直接提供的信息. 探测器返回对象位置作为边框,连同类和置信分数.
虽然可以自信地检测出一辆车,但这并不意味着是否错过了另一辆车,或者检测到的箱子是否被准确放置 [1].
在运行期间,没有用于检查结果的地上真实标签。
在选择性卸载中,质量估计器在花费通讯和服务器计算预算之前,只选择云卸载的可疑框架,以尽量提高最终检测质量,同时降低卸载成本,提供了决策信号.

blocks.en:
Producing this decision signal also consumes edge resources.
A dedicated neural network head can reuse the detector’s features [ 1 , 2 ] , making GPU execution alongside detection a natural choice.
As illustrated in Fig. 2 (a), neural scoring adds a stage to the GPU already running detection.
With detection and GFL quality estimation on the GPU, Fig. 3 shows lower average CPU utilization alongside a more heavily used GPU. This opportunity extends beyond Jetson: CoDL improves on GPU-only inference by sharing work with the CPU across Snapdragon and Kirin mobile SoCs [ 3 ] .
This suggests a design opportunity and challenge: Fig. 2 (b) proposes to move the quality estimator to the CPU, while keeping the GPU focused on detection. However, existing neural heads require matrix multiplications that are inefficient on the CPU.
Constructing the estimation operations that the CPU can process efficiently is therefore necessary.
blocks.zh:
生成这个决定信号也会消耗边缘资源.
专用神经网络头可以再用探测器的特征[1,2],使GPU执行并同时检测一个自然选择.
如图2(a)所示,神经分数为已经运行的GPU检测增加了一个舞台.
在GPU的检测和GFL质量估计中,Fig. 3 显示平均CPU利用率较低,同时使用较多的GPU. 这个机会超越了Jetson:CoDL通过与CPU共享Snapdragon和Kirin Mobile SoCs[3]的工作,改进了GPU唯一的推论.
这暗示了设计机会和挑战:图2(b)建议将质量估计器移至CPU,同时将GPU的重心放在检测上. 然而,现有的神经头需要基质相乘,在CPU上效率低下.
因此,需要构建CPU能够高效处理的估计操作.

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Selective offloading between edge and cloud.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1: 有选择地在边缘和云之间卸载.

blocks.en:
We introduce PTC-IoU (Predictive Temporal-Consistency IoU, abbreviated as PTC), which jointly considers the quality signal and its execution features. For example, vehicles generally persist across adjacent video frames, with short-term continuity in position and size.
PTC defines three cues (detection persistence, association clarity, and localization consistency) using the detector’s existing bounding boxes and confidence scores. It replaces image-feature processing and neural scoring with compact box histories and arithmetic on box overlaps and motion.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了PTC-IoU(Previous Timor-Consistency IoU,缩写为PTC),它共同考虑质量信号及其执行特征. 例如,车辆一般跨越相邻的相邻录像框而持续存在,其位置和尺寸具有短期的连续性.
PTC 使用探测器已有的边框和置信分数定义了3个提示(检测持续性,关联清晰度和本地化一致性). 它用紧凑的盒子历史取而代之的是图像特性处理和神经分数,并在盒子重叠和运动上取而代之的是算术.

blocks.en: Our primary contribution is a lightweight detection quality estimation function with CPU-friendly execution: enabling efficient edge deployment while maintaining competitive accuracy. Experimental results show that our estimator achieves competitive quality while cutting per-frame processing latency and energy consumption on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super testbed. Code and experiments are publicly available 1 1 1 Source code: https://github.com/cm-edge/byd-acc . .
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是轻量级检测质量估计功能,这种功能便于CPU执行:在保持竞争性准确性的同时,能够高效地进行边缘部署。 实验结果表明,我们的估算器在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano超级试验台上削减每帧处理延迟和能耗的同时,取得了具有竞争力的质量。 代码和实验公开 1 1 资料来源:https://github.com/cm-edge/byd-ac. . . ..

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Quality signals for selective inference. SelectiveNet jointly learns prediction and rejection to balance error and coverage [ 4 ] . For object detection, IoU-Net estimates localization confidence [ 1 ] , while GFL combines classification and localization quality [ 2 ] . PTC instead derives a frame-level signal from existing box histories, avoiding additional neural scoring on the GPU.
blocks.zh: 选择性推论的质量信号. 选择性网络联合学习预测和拒绝,以平衡出错和覆盖. [4]. 对于对象检测,IoU-Net估计本地化自信[1],而GFL结合分类和本地化质量[2]. 反之,PTC从现有的盒式历史中获得帧级信号,避免了GPU上的额外神经分数.

blocks.en: Temporal cues from detections. Ramanagopal et al. identify potential missed detections through temporal and stereo inconsistencies, validated by a learned classifier without ground-truth labels at inference [ 5 ] . The IoU tracker associates detections using box geometry without new image features [ 6 ] . HOTA distinguishes detection, association, and localization in ground-truth-based tracker evaluation [ 7 ] . PTC uses detection persistence, association clarity, and localization consistency to produce a deterministic CPU score for frame selection.
blocks.zh: 探测到的瞬间信号 Ramanagopal等人通过时间和立体不一致来识别可能错失的检测,在推论中由没有地面真实标签的有学问的分类员验证[5]. IoU追踪器的关联检测使用没有新图像特征的盒子几何检测[6]. HOTA在基于地面的跟踪器评价中区分了检测、关联和本地化[7]。 PTC使用检测持久性,关联清晰度,以及本地化一致性来生成一个决定性的CPU分数来进行帧选择.

blocks.en: Reducing the cost of cooperative inference. NoScope combines temporal difference detectors and specialized cascades for object-presence queries over fixed-camera video [ 8 ] . Cao et al. use a difficult-case discriminator to divide images between local and remote detectors [ 9 ] . Qiu et al. estimate offloading quality gains from local detections under an upload budget [ 10 ] . Budget-dependent estimator placement can skip local inference for offloaded frames [ 11 ] . We focus on the local cost of producing the selection signal, assessing latency, throughput, and energy alongside final detection average precision (AP) at different offload budgets.

blocks.en: Resource-aware execution. CoDL partitions neural operators between CPU and GPU [ 3 ] , while Band schedules DNN subgraphs across heterogeneous mobile processors [ 12 ] . Both optimize a given neural workload. With detection and GFL sharing the GPU ( Fig. 3 ), GPU utilization is 66.1%, while CPU utilization averages 13.9% across cores. This imbalance motivates PTC’s joint design of the quality representation and scoring operations: arithmetic on compact box histories makes scoring inexpensive on the CPU.
blocks.zh: 资源意识执行. CoDL在CPU和GPU之间分割神经操作器[3],而Band将DNN子图分出跨多样移动处理器[12]. 两者都优化了给定的神经工作量. 由于检测和GFL共享GPU(图3),GPU利用率为66.1%,而CPU利用率平均为13.9%跨核心. 这种不平衡刺激了PTC对质量表现和评分业务的联合设计:在紧凑的盒式历史中进行算术使评分在CPU上便宜.

blocks.en: Baselines. The local detector combines Faster R-CNN [ 14 ] and MobileNetV3-Large [ 15 ] . The GPU alternatives are an IoU-regression head inspired by IoU-Net [ 1 ] and a GFL-based head trained with quality focal loss [ 2 ] . Both reuse backbone features, pooling regions to 7 × 7 × 256 7\times 7\times 256 before two 1024-unit hidden layers. An XGBoost CPU predictor [ 16 ] , including temporal feature extraction, tests whether CPU placement alone provides inexpensive scoring. Each system comparison includes the complete scoring path.
blocks.zh: 基线。 本地探测器结合了更快速的R-CNN [14]和MobileNetV3-Large [15]. GPU替代品是由IoU-Net[1]所启发的IoU后退头和以GFL为主并经过质量焦距损失培训的头[2]. 两种再利用骨干特性,集合区域为7×7×256 7\times 7\times 256在两个1024单元隐藏地层之前. XGBoost CPU预测器 [16],包括时间特征提取,测试CPU的放置是否单独提供廉价分数. 每次系统比较都包含完整的得分路径.

blocks.en:

Timing, utilization, RAM, and energy use separate benchmark runs in case of interference.
Totals and paired increments are rounded separately. The quality replay retains the original full-resolution detector pair and uses the replay settings described below.

Neural-head training includes MOT17-specific training. Replay ranks frames within each evaluation partition and substitutes cached stronger-detector results for the selected fraction. AP uses IoU 0.7, averaged per frame for the vehicle datasets and pooled across detections for MOT17. PTC retains boxes at confidence 0.5 on UA-DETRAC and 0.1 on UAVDT and MOT17 according to their different object sizes.

blocks.en: IV-B Local processing latency and throughput
blocks.zh: 四-B 当地处理延迟和吞吐量

blocks.en:
We measured per frame estimation latency by calculating the difference in mean frame time between each estimator condition and its paired detector-only runs. Fig. 4 (a) shows that PTC needs 2.2 ms per frame, compared with 10.3–10.4 ms for the GPU heads, accelerating about 4.7 × 4.7\times faster.
The reported total is 69.3 ms for PTC versus 77.4–77.6 ms for the GPU heads, a 10.5–10.7% reduction, or about 8 ms saved per frame. Fig. 4 (b) shows sustained throughput under the bursty workload. The comparison includes pipelined and non-pipelined versions of PTC and XGBoost. The GPU heads reach 12.91–12.92 frames/s, while PTC reaches 14.41 frames/s, an 11.5–11.6% increase.
blocks.zh:
我们通过计算每个估计条件与其配对探测器只运行之间的平均帧时间相差来测量每个帧估计延迟. 图4 (a)显示,PTC每帧需要2.2 ms,而GPU头需要10.3–10.4 ms,加速了约4.7×4.7正时.
据报,方案支助和技术合作的总数为69.3米,而GPU头为77.4至77.6米,减少10.5至10.7%,即每帧节省约8米。 图4(b)显示,工作量过大,持续吞吐量。 比较内容包括管道版和非管道版的PTC和XGBoost. GPU头达到12.91-12.92帧/秒,而PTC达到14.41帧/秒,增长11.5-11.6%.

blocks.en:
Computation and placement matter together. Due to neural-head overhead and GPU executing features, baselines like IoU-head and GFL-head incure over 10 ms of added latency. PTC’s compact representation suits CPU execution which has better speed for arithmetic and sequential operations (cpu has higher clock speed and lower latency for those operations).
XGBoost is also happening on CPU but has a more complex model and feature extraction because its learning based approach requires more computation.
blocks.zh:
计算和放置在一起很重要。 由于神经头部高空和GPU执行功能,IoU头和GFL头等基线超过10毫秒的加长。 PTC的紧凑表示方式适合CPU的执行,它对于算术操作和相继操作具有更好的速度(cpu的时钟速度较高,这些操作的延迟度较低)。
XGBoost也在CPU上出现,但具有更复杂的模型和特征提取,因为其基于学习的方法需要更多的计算.

blocks.en:
As a consequence, PTC’s lightweight scoring implementation achieves higher throughput compared to the GPU heads. Except PTC’s improvement in throughput over baselines, there are two worth noting points:
a) Placement is not the only factor: XGBoost runs on CPU but has a significant overhead, which limits its throughput at 12.17 frames/s.
PTC’s simplified computation contributes to its lower latency and higher throughput, even though it also runs on CPU.
b) Pipelining: PTC’s pipelined and non-pipelined throughput is very close since its scoring overhead is already low, the benefit of pipelining is limited. As contrasted, XGBoost has a significant overhead on CPU, so pipelining remove the CPU bottleneck and allows the GPU to process frames while CPU is scoring, which increases throughput. This also verifies XGBoost’s CPU bottleneck.
The detector-only baseline is 67.1 ms per frame, which means if we select a more lightweight detector, the improvement in both latency and throughput from PTC over the GPU heads can be even more significant. However, XGBoost’s will not benefit too much since its CPU bottleneck will account for a larger fraction of the total frame time.
blocks.zh:
因此,与GPU头相比,PTC的轻量级分数执行实现了更高的吞吐量. 除了方案支助和技术合作在基线上的吞吐量增加外,还有两点值得注意:
(a) 联合国 放置不是唯一的因素:XGBoost运行在CPU上,但有一个很大的间接费用,这限制了它的吞吐量为12.17帧/秒.
PTC的简化计算有助于降低其延迟度和更高的吞吐量,尽管它也运行在CPU上.
(b) 国家 管道线 : PTC的管道和非管道输送量非常接近,因为它的分数高得已经很低,管道输送的好处有限。 相形之下,XGBoost在CPU上具有显著的间接费用,因此平流管去除CPU的瓶颈并允许GPU在CPU打分时处理帧,这增加了吞吐量. 这也验证了XGBoost的CPU瓶颈.
只有探测器的基准量为每帧67.1ms,这意味着如果我们选择了更轻量级的探测器,那么PTC对GPU头的延迟和通量的改进可能更为显著. 但是,XGBoost不会给太多好处,因为其CPU瓶颈将占总帧时间的更大部分.

blocks.en: Fig. 8: Final detection quality at equal server budgets. Each point combines stronger detections for selected frames with local detections for the rest. Compare curves vertically at the same fraction, where higher AP means better final results. Shading spans the GPU-head curves, and dashed lines mark Tab. II ’s 30% comparison. Dotted lines mark local-only and stronger-only results. Scoring settings appear in § IV-A . AP uses IoU 0.7.

blocks.en: IV-C Processor utilization and memory footprint
blocks.zh: 四-C 处理器的利用和记忆足迹

blocks.en:
Fig. 6 reports whole-system load under the bursty workload used to measure sustained throughput at its full speed.
GPU utilization is sampled every 40 ms, and CPU utilization is averaged across six cores.
PTC keeps average GPU utilization close to the neural baselines (67.5 vs 67.7–67.9%), while CPU utilization is surprisingly lowest among all estimators, counter-intuitive to what we might expect from a CPU-based estimator.
blocks.zh:
图6报告了整个系统在用于全速衡量持续吞吐量的急剧工作量下的工作量。
GPU利用率每40ms抽样,CPU利用率平均为6个核心.
PTC保持平均GPU利用率接近神经基线(67.5对67.7-67.9%),而CPU利用率在所有估计器中却出乎意料地最低,与我们可能从基于CPU的预测器中预期的相反。

blocks.en:
Compared with the GPU heads, it sustains higher throughput with similar GPU utilization and slightly lower CPU load, cross-vrifying PTC’s lower per-frame processing latency.
PTC’s low CPU load is consistent with the work required by each scoring path. Although the neural heads execute tensor arithmetic on the GPU, the CPU still sets up and dispatches RoI pooling and prediction operators and aggregates the returned scores. PTC computes directly from compact box histories, avoiding these additional GPU dispatches and feature-tensor handling. Process-time measurements support this interpretation: PTC adds 1.7 core-ms of CPU work per frame, compared with 5.2–5.3 core-ms for the GPU heads, summing CPU time across process threads. This measures the complete scoring path rather than attributing its cost to individual host operations.
blocks.zh:
与GPU头相比,它保持了较高的吞吐量,其GPU利用率相近,CPU负载也略低,交叉式PTC的每帧处理活性更低.
PTC的低CPU负载与每个打分路径所需的工作一致. 虽然神经头在GPU上执行收分数算术,但CPU仍然设置并发送了RoI集合和预测操作员并汇总了返回的分数. PTC直接从紧凑的盒子历史中计算出,避免了这些额外的GPU调度和特性分解处理. 过程时间测量支持这种解释: PTC每帧增加了1.7个核心-ms的CPU工作,而GPU头则增加了5.2–5.3个核心-ms,对CPU时间进行跨过程线的相接. 这衡量的是完整的评分路径,而不是将成本归因于个别东道业务。

blocks.en:
While XGBoost has lower throughput, it instead uses most CPU among all estimators. Lower GPU utilization reveals that its low efficiency of GPU utilization is due to the CPU bottleneck blocking GPU running on full speed.
Regarding the memory footprint shown in Fig. 6 (c), PTC’s compact computing representation and small box history result in a smaller memory footprint compared to the GPU heads and XGBoost which require more memory for their more complex features and inputs.
blocks.zh:
虽然XGBoost的吞吐量较低,但它却在所有估计器中采用了大多数CPU. 较低的GPU利用率揭示出其GPU利用率低的原因是CPU瓶颈阻断了GPU全速运行.
关于图6(c)所显示的记忆足迹,PTC的紧凑计算表现和小盒历史导致的记忆足迹比GPU头和XGBoost要小,因为其更复杂的特征和投入需要更多的记忆.

blocks.en: IV-D Energy cost per completed frame
blocks.zh: 四-D 每架完成的能源费用

blocks.en:
Fig. 7 uses VDD_IN board power to compare energy cost under the bursty workload and fixed-rate input (4 frames/s). The former tests operation at sustained processing capacity while the latter compares methods under the same steady input demand.
As shown in Fig. 7 (a), under the bursty workload, GPU heads and PTC have similar power draw while XGBoost draws less power because of its sustained throughput has been affected by its CPU bottleneck.
We further calculated the per-frame estimation energy consumption in Fig. 7 (b),
besides about 4 × 4\times lower latency under the bursty workload, PTC surprisingly cuts up to 95% energy consumption per completed frame compared to the GPU heads.
blocks.zh:
图7使用VDD_IN板功率来比较在爆裂工作量和固定速率输入下(4帧/秒)的能耗. 前者在持续处理能力下进行测试,后者在相同的稳定输入需求下比较方法。
如图7 (a)所示,在繁忙的工作量下,GPU头和PTC拥有相近的功率抽取,而XGBoost则因为其持续的吞吐量受到其CPU瓶颈的影响而抽取较少的功率.
我们进一步计算了图7(b)中按框架估计的能耗。
与GPU头相比, PTC将每架完成的能源消耗削减95%,

blocks.en: We attribute this to PTC’s compact representation and lightweight scoring computation, which doesn’t overdraw the GPU and CPU, allocating the system at a more energy-efficient operating frequency. Another possible reason is that PTC’s higher throughput allows the system to process more frames in the same amount of time, reducing the board’s overall working time for the same workload. Since the power consumption of the other components on the board is relatively fixed, this lowers the marginal cost.
blocks.zh: 我们将此归因于PTC的紧凑的表示和轻量级分数计算,它并没有过度地绘制GPU和CPU,以更节能的运行频率分配系统. 另一个可能的原因是,PTC的较高吞吐量使系统能够以相同时间处理更多的帧,从而缩短了董事会在相同工作量下的总体工作时间. 由于板上其他部件的能耗相对固定,这降低了边际成本.

blocks.en: IV-E Competitive final detection quality
blocks.zh: 四-E 竞争性最后检测质量

blocks.en: TABLE II: Final detection AP at a 30% offload budget.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:最后检测AP 30%的下载预算.

blocks.en:
Useful selection at a low scoring cost. In Fig. 8 , we plot the final end-to-end detection quality (AP) after combining local and server results at different offload budgets.
Higher AP at the same budget means better final detections with the same fraction of frames sent to the server. The endpoints use entirely local or entirely stronger detections.
We rank the estimator scores and select the top fraction of frames for stronger detections, and then calculate the final AP after combining the stronger detections for selected frames with local detections for the rest. For example, at the 30% offload budget, Tab. II shows that PTC improves on local-only detection and random selection across all three datasets, while remaining within 0.002–0.013 AP of the better GPU head. These quality results complement the approximately 4.7 × 4.7\times scoring speedup measured in the separate FPN-320 hardware benchmarks ( Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
At most fractions, PTC’s final AP on UA-DETRAC and MOT17 is close to that of the better GPU head. On UAVDT, PTC is slightly below the better GPU head at higher offload fractions. We attribute this to that UAVDT’s aerial views are generally more challenging, and the it’s fast moving camera increase the complexity of the temporal context. For example, our design of L ​ o ​ c t Loc_{t} ( § III-C ) assumes that the motion of the object is relatively smooth, which may not hold in UAVDT.
The other two datasets are more stable and PTC’s temporal context is sufficient to provide a useful quality signal.

另外两个数据集比较稳定,PTC的时间背景足以提供有用的质量信号.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: PTC-IoU demonstrates the value of designing a quality signal together with its processor placement. Compact temporal box histories make auxiliary scoring inexpensive on the CPU while still providing useful information for selective offloading. Results show that an efficient CPU estimator instead reduces CPU usage. As a consequence, the energy yields the most significant improvement.
blocks.zh: PTC-IoU显示设计质量信号及其处理器位置的价值。 压缩时间框历史使得辅助积分在CPU上价格低廉,同时仍然为选择性卸载提供有用的信息. 结果显示,高效的CPU估计器反而会减少CPU的使用. 因此,能源的改善最为显著。

blocks.en: The quality results in § IV-E vary across datasets, with UAVDT suggesting sensitivity to rapid camera motion. Future work will extend temporal cues to handle rapid camera motion and persistent detection errors, and adapt offloading decisions to changing network and energy budgets.
blocks.zh: §IV-E的质量结果因数据集而异,而无人机显示对快速相机运动的敏感性. 今后的工作将延长时间提示,以处理快速相机运动和持续检测错误,并调整卸载决定,以适应不断变化的网络和能源预算。
